text: I see the 'bind the selected material to N' texture slotting but where the hell is the texture it is pulling from. it says i have Abalone Shell selected but no where on my interface do i see where you can select it
resolution: Closed the loop the MATERIAL SLOTS section left open: the slot rows offered to 'bind the selected material' but nothing showed where that selection is made. The picker has existed all along — the Materials pane on the left rail (Palette icon) opens the materials library, and clicking a card there sets the active material — but the focus panel never pointed at it. Now a 'selected' row heads MATERIAL SLOTS: swatch + name of the material a slot click will bind (Abalone Shell in the user's case), and pressing it jumps the left panel to the Materials library via a dedicated handler that always lands OPEN on the materials folder (a plain rail press would toggle-collapse an already-active pane). Slot-row tooltips now name the concrete material ('bind Abalone Shell to the front slot') instead of the abstract 'selected material'. Bundle verified via esbuild; hot-reloadable .tsx only.
